summary_en: 4,000,000 shares (5.91% of shares outstanding ex-treasury), ¥18.0 billion upper limit, ¥45,000 price ceiling (derived from limit ÷ shares), execution period 1 September 2026 to 19 March 2027, method ToSTNeT-3 and open market, authorized by board 28 August 2026. Note: 2:1 stock split effective 1 October 2026 will increase authorized upper limit to 8,000,000 shares post-split.
title_en: Notice regarding Determination of Matters Relating to Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief: Suzuken's board of directors on 28 August 2026 authorized the acquisition of up to 4,000,000 treasury shares (5.91% of shares outstanding, ex-treasury denominator 67,674,205 shares) for a maximum aggregate consideration of ¥18.0 billion. The acquisition will be executed between 1 September 2026 and 19 March 2027 via ToSTNeT-3 (off-exchange automated matching system) and open-market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange. The stated rationale is to conduct flexible capital allocation in response to changes in the operating environment. The filing notes that a 2:1 stock split is scheduled to become effective on 1 October 2026, which will increase the authorized upper limit to 8,000,000 shares on a post-split basis. As of 31 July 2026, the company held 4,492,999 treasury shares.
